mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, base_salary, meal_allowance, apply_start_date, apply_end_date FROM salary_setting WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND apply_start_date <= #{targetDate} AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= #{targetDate}) ORDER BY apply_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT insurance_id, apply_year, national_pension_rate, health_insurance_rate, long_term_care_rate, emp_insurance_rate FROM insurance_rate WHERE apply_year = #{applyYear}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY year_month DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY year_month DESC

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount FROM payroll_ledger WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND year_month = #{yearMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_ledger ( employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{insuranceId}, #{yearMonth}, #{salaryAmount}, #{overtimeAmount}, #{mealAmount}, #{totalPayment}, #{netPay}, #{isFinalized}, #{isSent}, #{nationalPensionAmount}, #{healthInsuranceAmount}, #{longTermCareAmount}, #{empInsuranceAmount}, #{incomeTaxAmount}, #{localTaxAmount} )
